text: What if you tripped and your speed doubled every second?
formula: Title question word for word (STANDARD 1.3), rate in the title (0.13). NO-NARRATOR TEST (plan_november 2026-11-23, STANDARD 5.3): lines are on screen only. Speed v(n) = 10 km/h x 2^n, n = seconds since the trip (10 km/h = running for the tram). Video: trip at 4.0 s, 1 video second = 1 story second, so n = t - 4.0.

text: Your tram is leaving. You just want to go faster.
formula: Opening wish (STANDARD 0.14); paid off by n15.

text: A normal trip stops you in a second.
formula: LEAN + reality first (2.11): a stumble ends in a fall or recovery within about a second.

text: This one doubles your speed. Every second.
formula: SNAPBACK: the rule. Milestones in the human part: Usain Bolt top speed 44.72 km/h (12.42 m/s, Berlin 2009) -> n = log2(4.472) = 2.16 (t 6.16); cheetah 104 km/h (29 m/s measured, Sharp 1997; Guinness fastest land mammal) -> n = log2(10.4) = 3.38 (t 7.38); bullet train 320 km/h (Shinkansen E5 / TGV top service speed) -> n = log2(32) = 5.00 (t 9.0).

text: You tripped over a pigeon. He's not sorry.
formula: Blame #1, set up on screen: the Pigeon walks into your path at 3.6 s and you trip over him at 4.0 s; he watches, unbothered.

text: Nothing slows you down. Not even air.
formula: The why: the what-if ignores drag; the speed keeps doubling.

text: That bang? You broke the sound barrier.
formula: Speed of sound in air at 20 C = 343 m/s = 1,235 km/h -> n = log2(123.5) = 6.95 (t 10.95). Sonic boom + vapour cone.

text: You could let go of the coffee. You don't.
formula: Blame #2, set up: you carry a coffee from the first frame. Milestone 13.27 s: Mach 5 = 5 x 1,235 = 6,174 km/h, n = log2(617.4) = 9.27; stagnation temperature T0 = T(1 + 0.2 M^2) = 293 K x 6 = 1,759 K = 1,486 C -> 'AIR AT 1,500 C'.

text: Earth curves away faster than you fall.
formula: Circular orbit speed at the surface sqrt(GM/R) = sqrt(3.986e14/6.371e6) = 7,909 m/s = 28,473 km/h -> n = log2(2847) = 11.48 (t 15.48). Escape speed sqrt(2GM/R) = 11,186 m/s = 40,270 km/h -> n = 11.98 (t 15.98). Earth's orbital speed around the Sun 29.78 km/s = 107,200 km/h -> n = 13.39 (t 17.39).

text: Faster than anything humans ever built.
formula: Parker Solar Probe record 692,000 km/h (~191.7 km/s, 24 Dec 2024, NASA; Guinness fastest spacecraft) -> n = log2(69,200) = 16.08 (t 20.08). Around Earth in 1 minute: 40,075 km x 60 = 2,404,500 km/h -> n = 17.88 (t 21.88).

text: The Moon is now one minute away.
But nothing can go faster than light.
formula: Special relativity: no massive object reaches c. One more doubling from 50% would be 100%, so the doubling has to stop here; the video says so plainly and from here the counter shows % of light speed.

text: So you just get closer. Forever.
Time slows down for you. Not for Earth.
formula: Time dilation gamma = 1/sqrt(1 - v^2/c^2): 99% -> 7.09 ('1 SECOND = 7 SECONDS ON EARTH'); 99.99% -> 70.7 ('1 MINUTE = 71 MINUTES ON EARTH'); 99.9999% -> 707 ('1 DAY = 2 YEARS ON EARTH', 707 days = 1.94 years).

text: Cross the whole galaxy before your coffee cools.
formula: Milky Way ~100,000 light-years across. Your time to cross = (D/c)/gamma. 1 year: gamma = 1e5 -> 1 - v/c = 1/(2 gamma^2) = 5e-11 -> 99.999999995% (t 36.4). 5 minutes: gamma = 100,000 x 525,960 min / 5 = 1.05e10 -> 1 - v/c = 4.5e-21 -> 99.9999999999999999995% (t 38.1). Five minutes of your time: the coffee is still hot.

text: Well. You wanted to go faster.
formula: Callback ending: pays off n1 while the speed keeps climbing.

text: What speed would you stop at?
formula: Closing question, specific and answerable (STANDARD 1.9); shown over the still-moving last shot.
